messages:
Mira: Heads-up — eu-west2 is seeing controller-manager restarts and a surge of failed GPU node onboarding since ~10:12 UTC. Dedicated pools are impacted.
Mira: Logs look like apiserver 504s when controller-manager tries attachments; seeing leader churn in etcd as well. Ops alert: https://alerts.internal/12345
Sam: Can you paste a few controller-manager log lines? wondering if this is kubelet CRI timeouts vs network egress problem.
Mira: quick snippet:
```
E0512 10:12:31.123456 1 controller_attach.go:142] attach failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
W0512 10:12:31.456789 1 leaderelection.go:243] failed to tryAcquireOrRenew: etcdserver: request timed out
```
Josh: etcd around leader flips shows slow disk i/o + connection resets:
```
2022-05-12T10:11:58Z etcdserver: rejected connection from 10.8.5.3: i/o timeout
2022-05-12T10:12:05Z etcdserver: leader changed from node-a to node-c
```
Irene: saw similar in ap-south — SNAT (ephemeral port) exhaustion on NAT gateway caused nodes' outbound to fail, which bubbled into apiserver timeouts and controller-manager leader churn.
Mira: that fits. New GPU nodes open many ephemeral connections (image pulls, telemetry, proxy handshakes). NAT metrics trending near 64k ephemeral ports.
ops-bot: [ALERT] eu-west2: apiserver 504 spike (p95 latency 1.6s) — severity: high
Sam: If SNAT is root cause options: (a) move GPU nodepool to subnet with dedicated NAT, (b) provision additional NAT gateways, (c) throttle parallel onboarding.
Josh: I'm also seeing increased etcd KV write latency during the spike — apiserver retries + controller churn amplify leader elections.
Mira: Immediate mitigations: paused GPU pool autoscaler and throttled onboarding to 1 node/min via infra flag. Executed: `kubectl annotate ns/gpu onboarding-rate=1 --overwrite`.
Mira: Also scaled controller-manager to 3 replicas (was 2) to reduce leader election impact while stabilizing.
Irene: spinning up a secondary NAT gateway in eu-west2 and routing new node subnets through it. Ticket opened with cloud: CLD-9876.
Sam: please lower image-pull parallelism too — patched nodepool config: `maxParallelDownloads=2` (containerd).
Josh: running a dedupe job to collapse pending attach reconciles so we don't hammer etcd: `scripts/reconcile-dedupe --cluster=eu-west2`.
Mira: after throttles + secondary NAT, error rate dropped ~70% and etcd leader stabilized around 10:30 UTC. Still monitoring.
ops-bot: [RESOLVE] eu-west2: apiserver 504 spike cleared — incident duration ~18m
Irene: postmortem action items: update GPU onboarding runbook, add ephemeral port guardrail and alert, add NAT capacity checklist for large nodepools.
Sam: cost note — temporary NAT doubled NAT egress bill for eu-west2 during the hour. Flagging to finance; cheaper than multi-hour outage.
Mira: follow-ups: (1) infra playbook for GPU onboarding with NAT checks, (2) autoscaler rate-limit knob, (3) new etcd KV latency alert correlated with apiserver leader churn.
Josh: Ill draft an RFC for an image-pull prefix cache to reduce outbound flurries from large onboarding waves.
Mira: thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: This thread will be archived into incidents/ after the postmortem is posted.
